info.title: Healthcare Plus API
info.description:
A comprehensive RESTful API for managing patients, appointments, medical records, and prescriptions in a multi-tenant hospital management system.
This API is designed with HIPAA compliance in mind, ensuring secure handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) through robust access controls, audit logging, and encryption.
It supports role-based access for administrators, doctors, nurses, and receptionists, and adheres to HL7 FHIR-compatible resource naming conventions where applicable.
Rate limit: 100 requests/minute per API key.
